connector.name: Obsidian MCP Secure
connector.registryDescription: Secure MCP server for Obsidian with OWASP Top 10 controls and full audit logging.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package obsidian-mcp-secure. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the dewtech-technologies account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: OBSIDIAN_API_KEY
env.description: API Key generated by Obsidian's Local REST API plugin (Settings -> Local REST API -> API Key)

env.name: OBSIDIAN_HOST
env.description: Host of the Local REST API (default: http://127.0.0.1)

env.name: OBSIDIAN_PORT
env.description: Port of the Local REST API (default: 27123)
